mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 60 degrees with overcast skies at Verona Community Park, and although the ISS passes overhead tonight, you will not be able to see it due to the clouds.
There is no new city news to share today and no new important emails have arrived in our inbox.

We have a busy couple of days ahead! Today, you can participate in yoga at Insight Wellness, enjoy Thursday night festivities at ART House, or join the crowd for trivia at Hop Haus Brewing Co. Tomorrow, look forward to live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee, along with the Main Street Trick-Or-Treat event in Hometown Junction Park.
The Verona Police Department has not released a weekly report, so there are no specific incidents to review today.
If you are craving a treat, today's flavor of the day is OREO REESE'S Cheesecake, and the store will be ready to serve you when it opens today at 10:00 AM.
